parameters.content:
## Compile your featured customer testimonials

### How it works
For marketing teams: collect unused, featured testimonials from Google Sheets or Airtable and create one square compilation video with customer attribution, ratings and branding. The monthly trigger runs on the first day; selection uses Featured and Status, not a date filter. After success, sheet rows receive the video link and compiled status. Airtable has no automatic write-back. Social publishing is not included.

### Setup
1. Install **@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL **https://api.zvid.io**; select it on every Zvid node.
3. Connect both Google Sheets nodes to the same spreadsheet and tab. Use headers **Quote, Author, Role, Company, Rating, Featured, Status, VideoUrl**. Add at least **minQuotes** usable quotes, set **Featured=true**, and leave **Status** empty.
4. In **Config**, set **brandName**, the call to action, **minQuotes**, **maxQuotes** and accessible **musicUrl**. For Airtable, switch **source** to **airtable**, set the base/table and connect a Bearer Auth credential with read access.
5. **dryRun=false** renders and spends Zvid credits. Optional **dryRun=true** requires a Zvid node exposing **Project → Create** for an editor draft and quote. Test manually before enabling the schedule.

### Customization
Use Config for colors, fonts, quote limits and month labels. [Full setup guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/testimonial-compilation.md).

## 1. Configure the monthly run

Start with Test manually. Set your brand and source in Config; check the monthly schedule and workflow timezone before activation.

## 2. Select unused featured quotes

Choose Google Sheets or Airtable. Both paths keep featured rows with a quote and empty Status; minQuotes must be met. Nothing to compile explains why no video was started.

## 3. Build and validate the compilation

Check the selected customer quotes and attribution. The music guard checks the track; the builder creates the square video, and validation returns the payload checks and credit quote.

## 4. Preview or render

The default false branch renders. Optional dryRun=true saves an editor draft and reports the quote; that branch requires Project → Create support in the installed Zvid node.

## 5. Wait for the finished video

Submit one compilation, then poll its job until completion or timeoutMinutes. A render error stops the run; check the existing Zvid job before starting another paid render.

## 6. Record results and watch

Sheet mode writes Status and VideoUrl for the included rows; Airtable records need manual follow-up. Run summary keeps the link. Open Watch video → Binary → data → View; missing links skip the download.
